mapper.insert: insert into platform_user_tenant (id, user_id, tenant_id, created_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{tenantId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: delete from platform_user_tenant where user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.select: select count(1) > 0 from platform_user_tenant where user_id = #{userId} and tenant_id = #{tenantId}
select ut.tenant_id from platform_user_tenant ut inner join platform_tenant t on t.id = ut.tenant_id and t.deleted_at is null where ut.user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id, tenant_id, created_at from platform_user_tenant where tenant_id = #{tenantId}
